title: ModeChange
description: A change of entry authorization mode (P-37; RISK-060..062, API_SPEC §4 MODE_CHANGE). Moving to MANUAL_APPROVAL is always allowed; enabling automation needs re-auth, a typed phrase and RISK-061. An automatic demotion (RISK-062) is recorded here too; only the user re-enables automation.

schema_version.description: Schema version (DATA-010). Breaking changes need a migration and an ADR line.

params.description: Present with value FIXTURE when fixture values of unapproved parameters are in effect (RISK-005, RISK-066 item 3, MI-045). Absent otherwise; the spec names no value for the approved case.

fixture_demo_mode.description: Fixture demo only: the entry authorization mode the user set for this run in fixture_demo_mode (RISK-066 item 4). Absent outside fixture demo.

mono_seq.description: Engine monotonic sequence number for ordering within a process (DATA-003). Optional because records not written by the engine (research, Guardian ingest) have none.

anyOf.description: Originating command. Null for an automatic demotion.

cause.description: User change, or automatic demotion to human approval (RISK-062).

anyOf.description: RISK-062 cause: a trigger T2-T27, strategy demotion (RES-040), two consecutive rejected orders, or an EXE-060 breach.
Strategy concerned for a per-strategy auto_approved change under AUTO_APPROVED_STRATEGIES.
